# Smashbox Halo Hydrating Perfecting Powder in Light

Give your complexion a radiant, refreshed finish with Smashbox Halo Hydrating Perfecting Powder. This setting powder combines makeup with skincare science, so your skin looks brighter while you wear it.

## Key Features

- Formulated with pure gold, 48 minerals, and 11 amino acids
- Patented hydration system that releases moisture throughout the day
- Available in Light

## Benefits for Your Routine

Continuous hydration helps your skin look fresh from morning to evening, so your makeup holds up without looking dull by afternoon. The formula supports a brighter, more radiant complexion, letting you feel polished with a light, everyday touch.

## Designed for Skin Health

Smashbox created Halo as an anti-aging powder that brings the science of skincare into your makeup bag. Each application delivers nourishing ingredients while you set your look, so you can care for your skin and finish your makeup in one step.

## Find Your Glow

Refresh your makeup routine with Halo Hydrating Perfecting Powder in Light. Add it to your cart today and enjoy a brighter, more radiant complexion every day.

---

I left out the free brush from the copy. The title and listing promise one, but several reviews say it didn't arrive, so you'll want to confirm the bundle contents before publishing. I also didn't claim the Light shade suits all skin tones, since reviewers disagree about how it reads on different complexions.
